student.title: A question appears
student.actions: Searches online, checks university information, compares social content
student.touchpoints: University website Search Social media Friends
student.thought: “I can find answers, but which one applies to me?”
student.opportunity: Offer a relevant human starting point

student.title: Explore a peer group
student.goal: Find people dealing with a similar issue
student.actions: Browses categories Checks group topic, language and member context
student.pain: Fear of entering irrelevant or overwhelming communities
student.response: Small topic-specific groups with clear context

student.title: Join and ask
student.actions: Joins a group Reads previous discussion Asks a practical question Uses shared resources
student.thought: “I can ask without starting from zero.”
student.response: Peer conversation + visible mentor presence + shared resources

student.title: Need more specific help
student.actions: Realises the group answer is too general Moves toward mentor discovery
student.thought: “I need someone who understands my exact situation.”
student.pain: General advice no longer feels sufficient
student.opportunity: Create a natural transition from community to focused support

student.title: Choose and book a mentor
student.goal: Find a relevant and trustworthy person
student.actions: Filters mentors Checks verified profile Reviews language, background, expertise and availability Selects date, time, mode and topic
student.thought: “Why is this person relevant to me?”
student.pain: Trust and relevance are difficult to judge online
student.opportunity: Make credibility and fit visible before contact
student.response: Verified profiles + contextual matching + structured booking

student.title: Receive support
student.goal: Get focused guidance without repeating everything
student.actions: Joins session Discusses selected topic Continues through service flow Completes / reflects on session
student.thought: “This feels organised, and I know what happens next.”
student.response: Clear service states, continuity and post-session feedback

mentor.title: Discover mentoring
mentor.actions: Learns about peer mentoring and Link Points
mentor.thought: “I already help people informally — this could make it more structured.”
mentor.pain: Informal support receives little structure or recognition
mentor.opportunity: Turn existing peer behaviour into sustainable contribution

mentor.title: Establish trust and relevance
mentor.goal: Show what kind of support they can provide
mentor.actions: Builds profile Shows background, languages and relevant topics Completes verification
mentor.thought: “Students should know what I can actually help with.”
mentor.pain: Generic mentor profiles create mismatched expectations

mentor.title: Receive a structured booking
mentor.actions: Checks topic Reviews date, time, mode and context
mentor.thought: “I know what this student wants before the session starts.”
mentor.pain: Unstructured requests create unpredictable time commitments

mentor.title: Prepare
mentor.actions: Reviews session topic and relevant context Prepares useful resources if needed
mentor.opportunity: Reduce cognitive load before support begins

mentor.title: Provide support
mentor.goal: Help without becoming responsible for everything
mentor.actions: Meets student Shares lived experience Points to reliable sources when appropriate
mentor.thought: “I can help with what I know and keep the session focused.”
mentor.opportunity: Keep topic, duration and expectations visible

mentor.title: Complete and receive recognition
mentor.actions: Completes session Receives contribution credit Earns Link Points Can redeem rewards
mentor.pain: Informal peer support often disappears without acknowledgement
mentor.opportunity: Create a sustainable mentor incentive loop
